title: Vampire Vape Sweet Lemon Pie Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Sweet Lemon Pie from Vampire Vape captures the delicious, sweet comfort of a classic Lemon tart to perfection. Taste a sweet, sharp, slightly sour lemon curd with hints of vanilla layered over a rich, crumbly biscuity pastry base. Irresistibly zesty and dreamily decadent, this magical dessert flavour is the perfect sweet treat at any time of day. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production, and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. These Vampire Vape Nic Salt e-liquids are perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts along with a super-smooth throat hit. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings.
